name: MFAPushApps
label: Azure MFA push notification apps
helpText: Enables or disables the Azure Multi-Factor Auth Client and Azure Multi-Factor Auth Connector service principals. CIPP's Send MFA Push and MFA OTP verification need both apps enabled.
executiveText: Keeps the Microsoft apps behind MFA push verification in a known state, so help desk identity checks work when they are needed.
docsDescription: Grades two facts from the ServicePrincipals cache: the Azure Multi-Factor Auth Client (appId 981f26a1-7f43-403b-a875-f8b09b8cd720) and Azure Multi-Factor Auth Connector (appId 1f5530b3-261a-47a9-b357-ded261e17918) service principals match the configured state; a missing principal grades enabled, the platform default. Remediation PATCHes the appId-addressed upsert endpoint for each with Prefer: create-if-missing.

Enabled.label: Enable the Azure MFA push notification apps
